crossRefs.note: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
For from of old men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, nor has the eye seen a God besides you, who works for him…
(as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),
There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as has not happened since there…

translations.web: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
translations.bsb: Never before has anyone heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
translations.kjv: Since the world began was it not heard that any man opened the eyes of one that was born blind.
translations.asv: Since the world began it was never heard that any one opened the eyes of a man born blind.
